scenario.summary: Regression for z10-27984 on Multistore13: a registered user places a COD order with the Custom Flat Rate shipping method selected, then starts a second order and checks that no shipping method is auto-selected (shipping cost 0 before selection) and that the selected method price equals shipping plus handling, on both orders.
steps: Sign in with username/password on the Multistore13 webstore and empty the cart
Order 1: add sku1 at quantity 1, open the cart, check out, check the Shipping Address heading, click Ship Complete
No shipping radio is checked and shipping cost is 0; select #FLAT-1; selected price = shipping + handling
Pay with COD, place the order and check the thank-you banner
Order 2: add sku2 at quantity 1, reach the shipping options again; no method auto-selected and cost 0; select #FLAT-1; price = shipping + handling
stateChanges: One COD order is placed by the declared user (order 1)
The user's cart holds sku2 during order 2 and is emptied at the end
assertions: No shipping method auto-selected and shipping cost 0 before selection (orders 1 and 2, page.evaluate throws on failure)
Selected method price equals shipping cost plus handling (orders 1 and 2)
evidence: Title matches the flow; Testim z10_27984 bug-repro
Credentials (masked) name the existing registered user: USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED with preferred.required true (credential source).
Store MaxwellsHardwareMultistore13: the spec pins baseURL webstore-multistore13-z10-at; ZnodePortal StoreCode MaxwellsHardwareMultistore13 (PortalId 27) checked read-only with tda rows.
sku1 z-2200022 and sku2 z-2100025: PRODUCT_SIMPLE_IN_STOCK quantityUsed 1 each (alias product1, product2; preferred, not required). z-2100025 also appears in a spec comment only.

#FLAT-1 is clicked by a fixed selector in the spec: SHIPPING_FLAT_RATE_ON_STORE with shippingCode FLAT pins the record to that method (a need parameter, not a swapped value). Country assumed 'us' (the account's default address); assumption.

DOUBT: the Custom Flat Rate method must also be assigned to the user's Retail Customer profile (z10-28100 toggles exactly that and restores it). No key covers a profile's shipping assignment (see the z10-28100 entry); run the two serially.

DOUBT: proceedFromCart goes straight to shipping, so the account must already have a default shipping/billing address; USER_WEBSTORE_REGISTERED does not constrain that (same gap as the other retail checkout entries).
